name: Root cause analysis
purpose: Find evidence-backed causes of an incident or recurring defect and turn them into fixes.
trigger: An incident is resolved or a defect keeps recurring.
entry_criteria: Incident timeline or defect history exists
Logs and traces cover the time window

failure_paths.action: Record the gap as an action; do not guess a cause

exit_criteria: Each cause is backed by evidence; hypotheses are labelled
Every action has an owner and due date
communication_plan: Share the postmortem broadly; review actions monthly.
